events.verdict: Gafford (DAL) legally contests Bey's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Flagg's (DAL) is bracing for the contact from Fears (NOP) and the contact that occurs as he releases away from Fears is marginal.
Queen (NOP) legally contests Flagg's (DAL) jump shot attempt.

Murphy III (NOP) brings his right arm towards the ball as he pursues the rebound, and the contact with Gafford's (DAL) head/face is marginal. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Murphy III (NOP) applies his hand onto Gafford's (DAL) right arm and is not in a legal guarding position when contact occurs with Gafford that affects his shot attempt.
Murphy III (NOP) loses control of the ball on his own accord and Gafford (DAL) avoids making any contact with Murphy III.

Gafford (DAL) is losing control of the ball on his own prior to any contact from Murphy III (NOP).  The ensuing contact from Murphy III occurs after Gafford has lost possession and is considered marginal.

events.verdict: Gafford (DAL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Pelicans.
Gafford (DAL) legally contests Bey's (NOP) layup attempt in the paint.
Murphy III (NOP) momentarily brings his right arm to Flagg's (DAL) front and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Murphy III (NOP) initiates contact with Flagg's (DAL) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Flagg (DAL) initiates contact with Alvarado's (NOP) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Jones (NOP) moves forward into Flagg's (DAL) space and initiates body to body contact with Flagg that affects his shot attempt.
Queen (NOP) aligns himself along Gafford's (DAL) path and the contact during the layup attempt is marginal.
Gafford (DAL) initiates contact with Queen's (NOP) right shoulder that affects his driving shot attempt.
Flagg (DAL) cleanly deflects the ball away from Jones (NOP) during rebounding.  Any ensuing arm contact that occurs after the ball is deflected is considered incidental.
Jones (NOP) brings his right arm towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Flagg (DAL) as he secures the pass.

Gafford (DAL) firms up over his right leg in Jones' (NOP) path and absorbs the contact during the pick.  Gafford then brings his hands forward towards Jones as he releases away towards the basket, and this contact is marginal.
Jones (NOP) legally contests Flagg's (DAL) jump shot attempt.

As Murphy III (NOP) returns to the floor after he secures the rebound, his arms come down and contact occurs with Flagg's (DAL) head, which is marginal. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
